main_text.p: Hiph. הִצִּיעַ Stravit, Substravit, Stratum posuit: Fut. וְאַצִּיעָה Aut stratum ponerem, Psal.139. v.8. יַצִּיעַ Sternat aut Substernat, Jesa.58.5. Hoph. יוּצַּע Substernitur, Jesa.14.11. יוּצַּע Stratum erat, Substerneba-tur, Esth.4.43. Quibusdam est Pybal.
יָצוּעַ m. Stratum: Aff. יְצוּעִי Stratum meum, Gen.49.4. Plural. יְצוּעִים & constructè, יִצְעֵי Strata, 1.Parap.5.1. Aff. יְצוּעֵי Stratorum meorum, Psal.123.3.
מַצַּע masc. Stratum: קַצַּר הַמַּצַּע Brevius est stratum, Jesa.28.20.

יָצַק Fudit, Effudit, Infudit, Perfudit, Profudit: Quandoque intransitivè, Effundi, Effluere. Dicitur de Liquidis per se, & Liquefactus, ut auro, ære, & aliis metallis, quæ fusa rursus confistunt, & firmiora fiunt. Inde Firmari, Durescere: Confistere, Collocari, Situm esse. Sæpe etiam cum יָצוּק formam confundit, quod accuratè distinguendum. Præter. abjectâ primâ radicali, & cum paragogico: יִצְקוּן לְחַשׁ Effuderunt submissam orationem, Jesa.26.16. Particip.Pahul. יוּצַק Fusus, Job.29.6. Plural. יְצוּקִים Fusi, 2.Paral.4.3. Plural.Fœm. יְצוּקוֹת Fusæ, 1.Reg.7.30. Infinit. בְּצַקֵּת עָפָר לְמוּצָק Quum duresceret pulvis in duritiem, Job.38.38. id est, ut esset firmus ac solidus instar metalli fusi & consolidati, ut R.Salom.exponit. Quidam, Quum perfunditur pulvis, ut consistat firmus. Futur. אֶצַק מַיִם Effundam aquas, Jesa.44.3. Intransitivè, וַיִּצַק דָּם Et effluxit sanguis plagæ, 1.Reg.22.35. habetq; formam anomalam, quasi יִצַּק ex Quiescentium formâ, quum aliàs defectivum sit: Vide simile in יָקַץ. Hiph.Part. Fœm. מוֹצִקֶת Infundebat, 2.Reg.4.5. Futur. וַיִּצִיקוּ Et statuerunt, collocarunt, 2.Sam.15.24. Hoph.Præt. הוּצַק Infusa est, Psal.45.3. Particip. מוּצָק Fusum, 1.Reg.7.22.

Hebrew forms are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; vowel points and some letters are uncertain and should be checked against the original before use. The Hebrew line "בְּצַקֵּת עָפָר לְמוּצָק" and the "Quidam" gloss are uncertain. "ex Quiescentium formâ" and "Vide simile in" are as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout.
